answer_1.quote: Mamba's recurrent formulation avoids memory-intensive attention matrices, enabling efficient computation through convolution-like operations. This favorable scaling has spurred extensions to vision , multimodal processing , and genomics . Despite these advances, deploying Mamba models in resource-constrained environments remains challenging due to their millions of parameters .
